content.text:
`DeclaredTotals.svelte` already supplies both entity pages and stretches its three equal columns across the header. The third metric appears inset because `Metric`’s expanded variant explicitly sets `text-align: left` in `frontend/src/lib/ui/patterns.css:712`.

Smallest compliant change: add a typed presentation prop to `Metric`, such as `alignment?: "start" | "end"` with `"start"` preserving expanded defaults. Render a `data-alignment` attribute and implement its appearance in UI-owned CSS. In `DeclaredTotals.svelte`, select `"end"` only for the third item. Keep narrow stacked metrics start-aligned; apply end alignment at the existing 1000px three-column breakpoint. Avoid feature selectors reaching into `.member-value`, headings, or totals.

Document the prop in the UI README and add a gallery example. Extend the existing paired MP/funder test at `frontend/tests/entity-details.spec.ts:1838` to verify desktop third-label/value end alignment and its right edge against the following section; retain mobile stacking and overflow assertions. Extend gallery coverage to verify the alignment prop while preserving keyboard-scrollable exact values. No financial logic needs changing.
